rows.label: bf02030150_0010
rows.name:
So, by maximizing my whole body's
metabolism to maintain bodily functions...

rows.label: bf02030150_0020
rows.name:
I seem to have reverted
to a larval stage.

rows.label: bf02030150_0030
rows.name: Divine Beasts sure are convenient, huh?

rows.label: bf02030150_0040
rows.name:
Not every Divine Beast can do that.
It's something only I can do...

rows.label: bf02030150_0050
rows.name: Wait, Rex, are you angry?

rows.label: bf02030150_0060
rows.name: Not really...

rows.label: bf02030150_0070
rows.name:
I just feel stupid for
crying my eyes out.

rows.label: bf02030150_0080
rows.name: Sure does look like you're angry to me.

rows.label: bf02030150_0090
rows.name:
So when will you be
back to your old self?

rows.label: bf02030150_0100
rows.name:
Let's see... Give it 300 years,
and I'll be back to normal.

rows.label: bf02030150_0110
rows.name:
Th-three hundred years? But
I'll be long dead by then!

rows.label: bf02030150_0120
rows.name: Hmm. I suppose that's true.

rows.label: bf02030150_0130
rows.name:
But...what about my house?! Do I
have to live on the streets?!

rows.label: bf02030150_0140
rows.name:
Perhaps this is an
opportunity to fly the nest.

rows.label: bf02030150_0150
rows.name: You mean...pay rent?

rows.label: bf02030150_0160
rows.name: How stingy.

rows.label: bf02030150_0170
rows.name: Call it realistic...

rows.label: bf02030150_0180
rows.name: Still... I'm glad you're okay.

rows.label: bf02030150_0190
rows.name:
Oh, right! We can't relax. We
have to find Nia and the others.

rows.label: bf02030150_0200
rows.name: Nia? You mean the Driver and Blade who were with us?

rows.label: bf02030150_0210
rows.name: Yeah. They saved us.

rows.label: bf02030150_0220
rows.name: I do hope they are all right.

rows.label: bf02030150_0230
rows.name: Gramps, do you remember anything?

rows.label: bf02030150_0240
rows.name:
I crashed into trees countless times
on the way here...

rows.label: bf02030150_0250
rows.name: They probably fell off then.

rows.label: bf02030150_0260
rows.name: Hmm, that's not a whole lot to go on...

rows.label: bf02030150_0270
rows.name:
If you hit trees, why don't we look
for broken branches?

rows.label: bf02030150_0280
rows.name: I see. All right, let's do that.

rows.label: bf02030150_0290
rows.name:
By the way, Rex, is that a Core
Crystal I see shining on your chest?

rows.label: bf02030150_0300
rows.name: Just what happened to you?

rows.label: bf02030150_0310
rows.name:
That can wait. Finding Nia and the others
comes first.

rows.label: bf02030150_0320
rows.name: Oho! This makes things easy!
